name: Gattsuri PV Dashboard
author: satohata

sections.description:
Gattsuri PV Dashboard is a lightweight behavior analytics plugin for WordPress that tracks session-based page views and visualizes user engagement directly within the admin dashboard.

Unlike traditional analytics platforms that primarily focus on traffic acquisition, this plugin focuses on on-site behavior — helping site owners understand how deeply visitors navigate and interact with content.

The plugin provides behavioral indicators based on session-level page view activity, supporting:

• Content optimization
• Internal linking improvements
• User engagement analysis

All tracking data is processed locally within WordPress.
Optional third-party analytics integration may transmit data externally when configured by the administrator.

Japanese description:

がっつりPVダッシュボードは、訪問ユーザーの回遊行動と閲覧深度を可視化するための軽量行動解析プラグインです。

一般的なアクセス解析が流入分析に重点を置くのに対し、本プラグインはサイト内での動き（回遊・閲覧深度）にフォーカスしています。

コンテンツ改善や内部リンク設計の判断材料となる行動指標を、WordPress管理画面上でリアルタイムに確認できます。

Features

  • Session-based page view tracking
  • Engagement depth visualization
  • Real-time dashboard widgets
  • Internal navigation insights
  • Logged-in users excluded from tracking
  • Common bot and crawler filtering
  • Local data storage (privacy-friendly)

Dashboard Overview

Today’s Activity

  • Active visitors (real-time)
  • Total visitors (session-based)
  • Total page views
  • Current pages and referrer types

Engagement Depth Distribution

Visitors are grouped by session page views:

  • 1 page view
  • 2 page views
  • 3–4 page views
  • 5+ page views

This classification is a behavioral indicator for understanding browsing depth and engagement trends.

Percentage Metrics

Each percentage represents the proportion of visitors within each engagement level relative to total visitors during the selected period.

Data Storage

All tracking data is stored locally in the WordPress database.

No personal data is transmitted externally by default.
If a Measurement ID is configured, data will be sent to Google Analytics / Google Tag Manager.

Data Retention

Tracking logs older than 29 days are automatically deleted.

External Analytics Integration

An optional measurement ID field allows administrators to insert third-party analytics tracking scripts.

No data is transmitted unless configured by the administrator.

This plugin is not affiliated with any external analytics providers.

Privacy

The plugin stores anonymous session-based behavioral data only.

No personally identifiable information (PII) such as names, email addresses, or IP addresses is stored.

Site administrators are responsible for compliance with local privacy regulations.

External Services

This plugin connects to Google Tag Manager to load analytics scripts.
It sends the Measurement ID you configure in the plugin settings to Google’s servers when a page is viewed.

  • Service: Google Tag Manager / Google Analytics
  • Data sent: Measurement ID, page view data
  • When: On every page load where tracking is active
  • Terms of Service: https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/terms/us/
  • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • PHP 8.0 or higher

Pro Version

The Pro extension includes:

  • Week-over-week comparison with difference indicators (▲▼)
  • Historical week selection (going back to measurement start date)
  • Engagement depth distribution comparison by week
  • Per-page engagement analysis with 7-day and 28-day periods
  • Advanced filtering, sorting, and display count options
  • Per-page behavioral commentary
    For more information and to purchase, visit:
    https://satoruhatano.xsrv.jp/gattsuri-pv-dashboard/

License

GPL v2 or later

Author

Satoru Hatano
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/gattsuri-pv-dashboard directory, or install via the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen.
  3. Dashboard widgets will appear automatically.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin collect personal data?

No. The plugin stores only anonymous session-based behavioral metrics.

Does this plugin send data externally?

By default, no. All tracking data is stored locally. However, if you configure an optional Measurement ID in the settings, data will be sent to Google Analytics / Google Tag Manager.
